text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence spreads into daily life. One major problem is bias: if AI learns from unfair data, it may treat some groups badly. Fairness means making sure AI systems treat everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, because AI often collects personal information, and people deserve to know how their data is used. Transparency helps here—companies should explain clearly how their AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human values, not just profit. When developers, governments, and users work together, AI can be a powerful tool that benefits everyone.
